headline: Approved special one-day alcohol licenses, event permits, a junk dealer condition change, and a package store license transfer to 484 Merrimack St.
summary: Approved one-day wine and malt beverage licenses for a marathon, a gallery reception, a theatre, and several events at the Hellenic Center. Approved amplified sound permits for a fall busker series and the Lowell Hispanic & Latinx Festival, and a condition change for Kazanjian Used Parts Inc.'s junk dealer license. Approved a package store transfer to 484 Merrimack St. and voted to hold a public hearing on October 15, 2026, on a restaurant license transfer for 31 Reiss Ave.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 3, 2026 meeting, 3 yeas, 2 absent.

Approved Thomas Fiorelli's Special One Day License to sell wines only for the Overpainted Beats: Explosions of Blood gallery reception on October 3, 2026, at Ayer Lofts Gallery, 172 Middle Street, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved PJ Mercier's Special One Day License to sell wines and malt beverages for the 2026 Baystate Marathon on October 18 at 168 MLK Jr Way, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved Sophia Boucher's Special Events Permit for Amplified Outdoor Public Entertainment for the City of Lowell Fall Buskers Series at Derby Park, 66 Middle St., 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved the ratification of Amanda Étinge's Special One-Day License for "Mami Esther's Celebration of Life" on September 12, 2026, 3 yeas, 2 absent.

Approved Amanda Étinge's Special One-Day Licenses for "Celebration of Edo People" on September 19, 2026, and "Nigerian Independence Day Banquet" on October 3, 2026, at the Hellenic Center, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved Amanda Étinge's Special One-Day License for "Mami Theckla Lomga Celebration of Life" on October 10, 2026, at the Hellenic Center, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved Amanda Étinge's Special One-Day License for "Jojo & Alex 25th Wedding Anniversary" on October 17, 2026, at the Hellenic Center, 3 yeas, 2 absent.

Approved Diego Leonardo's Special Events Permit for Amplified Outdoor Public Entertainment for the Lowell Hispanic & Latinx Festival at Sampas Pavilion, 160 Pawtucket Blvd., dated September 26, 2024 in the minutes, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved changing the conditions of the Junk Dealer license held by Kazanjian Used Parts Inc., 705 Dutton Street, 3 yeas, 2 absent.

Approved Merrimack Repertory Theatre's Special One Day Licenses to sell malt beverages and wines during performances and the Annual MRT Gala at Lowell Memorial Auditorium, 50 East Merrimack Street, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Approved the transfer and change of location of the wine and malt beverages package store license for Valerie GEO Inc. (d/b/a Sophia's Greek Pantry North) to 484 Merrimack St., 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Voted to hold a public hearing on HLE TargetCO LLC's application to transfer the All Alcoholic Beverages restaurant license for 31 Reiss Ave. at the October 15, 2026 meeting, 3 yeas, 2 absent.
Placed the communications regarding incidents and events on file, 3 yeas, 2 absent.

Lowell License Commission | Meeting Minutes for 2026.09.17 
 
City of Lowell License Commission | 375 Merrimack St. Lowell, MA 01852  Page 1 of 4 
 
This meeting was held in City Council Chambers, second floor, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St. on 
Thursday, September 17, 2026, at 6:00 PM, and by Zoom invitation. 
Video of this meeting is available: https://www.youtube.com/live/QB3ZP6jYYcQ?si=skESmpOeIPaiGUmI 
 
ROLL CALL: 
On a roll call at 18:01, members present were, namely: Acting Chair, Commissioner Krieger, Commissioner 
Underwood, and Commissioner Uong. Commissioner Donahue and Commissioner Mercier were absent. 
  
MINUTES:  
1 Acceptance of the meeting mi nutes for September 3, 2026.  
Motion to accept the minutes of the September 3, 2026, License Commission meeting by 
Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 absent (C. Donahue, C. 
Mercier), APPROVED. 
2 Application by Thomas Fiorelli, for a "Special One Day License to sell/dispense Wines only," for the 
"Overpainted Beats: Explosions of Blood" gallery reception, to be held on Saturday, October 3, 
2026, from Noon to 4 PM at the Ayer Lofts Gallery, 172 Middle Street. 
Mr. Fiorelli spoke to the Commission about his event, which is a part of Lowell Celebrates Jack 
Kerouac Festival.  
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
3 Application by PJ Mercier, for a "Special On e Day License to sell/dispense Wines and Malt 
Beverages only," for the 2026 'Baystate Marathon,' to be held on Sunday, October 18, 11 AM to 3 
PM at 168 MLK Jr Way. 
Mr. Mercier reviewed his plans for the event and noted that he has operated several similar 
events over the years.  
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
4 Application by Sophia Boucher, Ci ty of Lowell Cultural and Special Events, for a "Special Events 
Permit for Amplified Outdoor Public Entertainment," for the City of Lowell Fall Buskers Series for 
Fridays & Saturdays from Noon to 8 PM in September and October at Derby Park, 66 Middle St. 
Ms. Boucher told the Commission about the fall busker program that the City sponsors to 
encourage traffic downtown.  
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED.

City of Lowell License Commission | 375 Merrimack St. Lowell, MA 01852  Page 2 of 4 
 
5 Application by Amanda Étinge, fo r the following "Special One-Day Licenses to sell/dispense Wines 
and Malt Beverages only" at the Hellenic Center, 41 Broadway Street; all events are 7 PM to 1 AM: 
Ms. Étinge answered questions about each of her events. She explained that the ratification was 
for an event that was moved last minute to this unlicensed venue. She explained that the Edo are 
a Nigerian tribe. She noted that the Celebration of Life was a normal wake-keeping, and invited 
everyone to the wedding.  
 
• Ratification of an application for "Mami Esther's Celebration of Life" on Saturday, September 12, 
2026, from 7 PM to 1 AM. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
• "Celebration of Edo People" on Saturday, September 19, 2026. 
• "Nigerian Independence Day Banquet" on Saturday, October 3, 2026. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
 
• "Mami Theckla Lomga Celebration of Life" on Saturday, October 10, 2026. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
 
• "Jojo & Alex 25th Wedding Anniversary" on Saturday, October 17, 2026. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
6 Application by Diego Leonardo, Latinx Communi ty Center, for a "Special Events Permit for 
Amplified Outdoor Public Entertainment" for live music and cultural performances, to be held at 
the Lowell Hispanic & Latinx Festival, September 26, 2024, from Noon to 8 PM at Sampas Pavilion, 
160 Pawtucket Blvd. 
Mr. Leonardo explained that the festival was moving from JFK Plaza in downtown Lowell to 
Sampas Pavilion in Heritage State Park, noting that this is the fifth annual Latinx Festival and that 
37 countries would be represented. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
7 Petition by Kazanjian Used Parts Inc., 705 Dutton  Street, Class 3 Auto Dealer and licensed Junk 
Dealer, to change conditions of the Junk Dealer license.
Lowell License Commission | Meeting Minutes for 2026.09.17 
 
City of Lowell License Commission | 375 Merrimack St. Lowell, MA 01852  Page 3 of 4 
 
David Grey spoke for Kazanjian Used Parts, Inc.; he explained that there had been a condition 
imposed on their Junk Dealer license because of a neighbor who had moved away, and that the 
condition limited their storage options on site. He supplied a letter from the new neighbor, who is 
amenable to the business keeping neat, organized outdoor storage. 
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
8 Application by Merrimack Repertory Theatre for "Special One Day License to sell/dispense Malt 
Beverages and Wines only," during pre-show and intermission for fourteen performances of "Dr. 
Jekyll and Mr. Hyde," fourteen performances of "The Complete Works of Jane Austen, Abridged," 
fifteen performances of "The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee," fifteen performances of 
"All the Great Books," fifteen performances of "Long Shot," and for the "Annual MRT Gala" at  
Lowell Memorial Auditorium, 50 East Merrimack Street. 
Carolyn Andrews and Christopher Torres represented the Repertory Theatre. They reviewed the 
Theatre’s annual plan and typical set up for concessions and intermission alcohol service.  
Move approval by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 
absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
9 Public hearing for an application by Valerie GE O Inc [d/b/a] Sophia's Greek Pantry North, Valerie 
Georgoulopoulos, proposed license manager for transfer and change of location of a "Wine and 
Malt Beverages" package store license to 484 Merrimack St. 
Ms. Georgoulopoulos spoke to the Commission about her application and her new location. 
At the hearing, no one spoke in favor or in opposition of the application. 
Motion to approve the application by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner 
Uong. 3 yeas, 2 absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
10 Request for a public hearing for an applicatio n by HLE TargetCO LLC [d/b/a] Showcase Cinema 
Lowell, to transfer of the "All Alcoholic Beverages" restaurant license for 31 Reiss Ave. Request 
public hearing be held at the October 15, 2026, License Commission meeting. 
Motion to hold a public hearing on the application at the October 15, 2026, License Commission 
meeting by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner Uong. 3 yeas, 2 absent (C. 
Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
11 Communications to Commission regarding incidents and events. 
Motion to place the matters on file by Commissioner Underwood; seconded by Commissioner 
Uong. 3 yeas, 2 absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED. 
  
ADJOURNMENT:

3 yeas, 2 absent (C. Donahue, C. Mercier), APPROVED.
